en: WASD/click: move  E: use  Stand behind the register to serve
zh: WASD/点击：移动  E：交互  站在收银台后自动结账

en: Order before opening or after closing: paid now, delivered before the next opening.
zh: 开店前或打烊后都能下单：下单即付款，下次开店前送到。

en: Pick what each slot holds; restocking keeps it full.
zh: 给每一格选商品，补货会自动补满。

en: No staff can be hired yet.
Click to place or select. R: rotate. Right-click: cancel.
zh: 点击摆放或选中，R 旋转，右键取消。

en: No storage that can hold that.
zh: 没有能放这种货的仓库。
不能拆掉最后一个门口。
已订的货需要放在这里。

en: That shelf can't keep this product.
zh: 这个货架放不了这种商品。

en: Stand in front of it first.
That save could not be loaded.
Carrying {qty} {product} to {fixture} slot {n} (E at storage to put back)
zh: 搬着 {qty} 件{product} → {fixture}第 {n} 格（在仓库按 E 可放回）

en: Carrying {product} to the {fixture} (E at cold storage to put back)
zh: 搬着{product} → {fixture}（在冷库按 E 可放回）

en: Steamed fish with ginger and scallion
That dish is sold at a different station.
zh: 这道菜要在另一种档口卖。

en: That is only for the kitchen.
Before opening choose a dish and today's target for each station slot. Short of ingredients the kitchen cooks until they run out.
zh: 开店前为每个档口格子选一道菜和今天的目标份数。原料不够时，做到用完为止。

en: No steam table or roast station yet.
zh: 还没有打菜台或烧腊档。

en: Dishes and what is in stock
That has to go against a wall.
Nothing is on order yet. Start the next day anyway?
zh: 还没进货，要进入下一天吗？

en: {per_slot} per slot · have {stock} (+{pending}) · last day {sold} · fits {room} more
zh: 一格 {per_slot} 个 · 现有 {stock}（+{pending}） · 上一天卖 {sold} · 还能放 {room}

en: Only a manager can run a department.

zh: 今天的班次（上午 | 下午）
任务优先级（数字大的先做）

en: Morale: wage {wage}, work {work} (days in a row {streak}, tasks today {tasks})
zh: 士气：工资 {wage}，工作 {work}（连续上班 {streak} 天，今天做了 {tasks} 件）

en: The importer does not sell that.
The importer has a minimum order.
zh: 不够进口商的最低起订量。

en: That is not a storage area.
Imports are cheaper but paid now and take a week or two by sea; they arrive on pallets to unload.
zh: 进口更便宜，但下单即付款，海运一到两周；到货是托盘，要卸货。

en: min {min} · {from}-{to} days at sea · local {local} · at sea {at_sea}
zh: 起订 {min} 个 · 海运 {from}-{to} 天 · 本地价 {local} · 在途 {at_sea}

en: That order is no longer open.
Finish the current group order first.
zh: 先完成手上的团购订单。

en: Is this the one from TikTok?
zh: 这就是网上很火的那个吧？

en: Mom wants me to grab soy sauce.

zh: 这里的饺子是全城最好的。

en: My friend told me about this place.
Do you sell by the case?
The kitchen needs this by Friday.
Wanted {product}, but the shelf was empty.
zh: 想买{product}，结果货架上已经空了。

en: {product} sells out fast here. Come early!
Nice store, but {product} costs more than elsewhere.
Good stuff but the line was slow.
Waited and waited, then gave up and left.
zh: 等了半天没人结账，干脆走了。

en: In and out in no time. Friendly staff!
zh: 结账很快，店员也很热情！

en: Grabbed {product} for dinner, tasted like home.
They have {product}!! Telling all my friends.
zh: 居然有{product}！马上告诉朋友们。
竟然没有{product}？大家都在聊它……

en: Wish the price tags were in English too.
Love the bilingual labels. Easy to shop here.
zh: 双语价签很贴心，买东西方便多了。

en: Our restaurant's order was ready on time. We'll be back.
zh: 餐馆订的货按时备齐了，下次还来。

en: They couldn't fill our restaurant's order.
zh: 餐馆订的货没备齐，太耽误事了。
